title: Lahaina banyan tree recovery
summary: Eight of 16 planned supports were added to the banyan tree's side branches about two weeks before the September 9 meeting. An arborist will return with a spider lift for more trimming once it is scheduled. The chair said the tree will stay closed another year and a half, after a July decision that no one would enter the park for two years so the tree can heal.
